relationships.subject: mGluR1
relationships.evidence_quote: This form of tagged LTD requires the activation of metabotropic glutamate receptor subtype 1 (mGluR1).

relationships.subject: nimodipine
relationships.evidence_quote: Nimodipine, an inhibitor of L-type voltage-gated calcium channels, also blocked tagged LTD.

key_findings: Tagged LTD occurs in the adult mouse ACC, requires mGluR1 and L-type calcium channels but not NMDA receptors.
Tagged LTD is reduced or blocked in an amputation model.
